shortDescription: Manage Device Groups on Dell PowerFlex

options.name: device_group_id
options.description: The ID of the device group. Mutually exclusive with I(device_group_name).

options.name: device_group_name
options.description: The name of the device group. Mutually exclusive with I(device_group_id).

options.name: hostname
options.description: IP or FQDN of the PowerFlex host.

options.name: media_type
options.description: Media type of the device group. Query and validation only; it cannot be modified.

options.name: new_device_group_name
options.description: New name for the device group (rename operation).

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the PowerFlex host.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number through which communication happens with PowerFlex host.

options.name: protection_domain_id
options.description: ID of the protection domain for device group identification/validation. Mutually exclusive with I(protection_domain_name).

options.name: protection_domain_name
options.description: Name of the protection domain for device group identification/validation. Mutually exclusive with I(protection_domain_id).

options.name: query_usable_capacity
options.description: Whether to query the usable capacity of the device group. This is a read-only operation.

options.name: spare_device_count
options.description: Spare device count for the device group.

options.name: spare_node_count
options.description: Spare node count for the device group.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the device group. Only C(present) is supported; the module manages existing device groups and does not create or delete them.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time after which connection will get terminated. It is to be mentioned in seconds.

options.name: username
options.description: The username of the PowerFlex host.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Boolean variable to specify whether or not to validate SSL certificate. C(true) - Indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. C(false) - Indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.
